conviction_note: The evidence nets out. The quarter is very likely weak: the CSI 300 fell 12.5% and the STAR 50 fell 31% in Q3 2026, so the RMB96.6M of mainland performance fees from Q2 should not repeat, and the international lines are still shrinking. But management already guided a full-year operating margin of about 30%, which implies roughly 24% for H2. The stock is down 27% since the Q2 print, trades at 0.59x net cash with EV at -$302M, and has no buyback running since the 2024 program lapsed. The last four confirmed prints moved it only -1.3% to +0.1%, so p_up is 50 and the expected move is 0. The findings sum to -0.4 and the scaled number is 0; the gap is the negative quarter balanced against a possible capital-return announcement and washed-out positioning.
bar: Disputed and thin, so every size is capped small. FY2026 revenue consensus is RMB2.53B on average (range 2.3-2.7B, S&P Global via https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/noah/forecast/, read 2026-11-24). With H1 revenue at RMB1,245.7M (Q1 625.8M + Q2 619.9M), that implies about RMB642M a quarter in H2. FY2026 EPS is about RMB9.85 per ADS (6 analysts, Oct 24 2026, Chartmill snippet; the page returned 403). With H1 non-GAAP net income of RMB371.9M (133.9M + 238.0M), that implies about RMB136-150M of non-GAAP net income a quarter in H2. The same stockanalysis page lists 2026 EPS at CNY21.03, which is impossible against H1 and is rejected. No company revenue or EPS guide exists. The only company guide is 'full-year operating margin ... about 30%' (Q2 call, https://www.webull.com/news/15479272959984640, 2026-08-25). With H1 margin at 36.3%, that implies about 23-25% for H2. Comparable quarter Q3 2025: revenue RMB632.9M, operating income 171.9M, non-GAAP net income 229.1M. JPMorgan Hold cut its target to $8.20 from $9.70 on 2026-11-10 (stockanalysis forecast page). My estimate for Q3 revenue is about RMB530-560M, roughly 8% under the average-implied H2 run rate, and Q4 usually carries more carry.
positioning_check: Short interest 260,927 ADS (prior month 255,177), 0.48% of shares outstanding, about 0.9% of the 30.15M float, 1.56 days to cover (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/noah/statistics/, page updated 2026-11-24). Not crowded. No usable option chain (baseline: unusable_chain, OI 137, put/call OI 1.4), so no skew and no implied move. Tape: -8.2% over 20 days, -48.8% from the 52-week high, 3.2% above the 52-week low. Earnings Whispers shows -27.2% post-earnings drift since the 2026-08-25 print (https://www.earningswhispers.com/stocks/NOAH). Unexplained volume spike on 2026-11-19: 3.82M ADS against a 20-day average of about 585k, then -6.3% on 11-20 and +4.9% on 11-23 (Yahoo chart). Market cap $432M against net cash of $734M (EV -$302M).

findings.finding: Q3 2026 revenue is likely to fall about 12-16% YoY to roughly RMB530-560M (Q3 2025: 632.9M). Two lines drive it. First, Q2's RMB96.6M of mainland private-secondary performance-based income will probably not repeat: China's Q3 market was the worst in years (CSI 300 -12.49%, ChiNext -27.8%, STAR 50 -30.7%; private stock-strategy funds +1.92% YTD at end-September, so few funds sit above their high-water marks). Second, the international lines are still contracting: Q2 international wealth management -31.3% YoY to 88.9M against a Q3 2025 base of 146.2M, international insurance -31.1%, overseas RM headcount -36%. On the average consensus that is about 8% under the roughly RMB642M a quarter implied for H2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Rebuilt from confirmed release dates with Yahoo daily closes. Q2'26 (released 2026-08-25 amc): -0.7%, on revenue -1.5% YoY. Q1'26 (2026-05-27 amc): -1.3%, revenue +1.8%, non-GAAP NI -20.7%. Q4'25 (2026-03-24): +0.1%, revenue +12.5%. Q3'25 (2025-11-25): -0.5%, on revenue -7.4%. A revenue decline has not moved this name on the print in the last four quarters.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The A-share sell-off and the Q2 international declines are public, and the stock has fallen 27% since the Q2 print. What argues against fully priced: the average FY revenue consensus of RMB2.53B still implies an H2 run rate above Q3 2025, so if analysts had fully absorbed the loss of Q2's carry, the consensus would sit near the 2.3B low.
findings.independence: Company segment figures: Q2 6-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001499543/000110465926100838/tm2623683d2_ex99-1.htm. Q3 2025 base: https://finviz.com/news/239078/noah-holdings-limited-announces-unaudited-financial-results-for-the-third-quarter-of-2025. Private-fund YTD returns: https://finance.eastmoney.com/a/202610253907169271.html. The market-to-company transmission is a proxy: the company has not confirmed Q3 carry.

findings.finding: The profit line will probably land inside what management already guided. The Q2 call guided a full-year operating margin of about 30% against a record 36.3% in H1, which implies about 23-25% in H2, or roughly RMB120-150M of quarterly operating income against 171.9M in Q3 2025. Cost cuts continue (H1 opex -11.6%, compensation -13.1%), so a non-GAAP net income near the implied RMB136-150M a quarter is the base case.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2'26 posted a record 34.8% margin with operating income +34% and the stock moved -0.7%. Q1'26 operating income +27.1% with non-GAAP NI -20.7%: -1.3%. Margin surprises have not paid on the print.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the company's own guide, so it is mostly priced. The only unpriced part is whether Q3 lands at the low end, which would mean operating income down 20-30% YoY.
findings.independence: The H1 cost figures come from the same transcript. The Q2 6-K (separate document) confirms Q2 operating income of 215.8M and compensation -13.1%. Same company, so not independent of the guide.

findings.finding: A capital-return announcement is possible and unpriced. The stock trades at $432M against $734M of net cash (EV -$302M, P/E about 5). The 2024 buyback (US$50M over two years from 2024-08-28) lapsed around August 2026 with about $34M used. The HKEX monthly return for October 2026 shows zero repurchases. Management said on the Q2 call it expects to 'sustain at least a comparable level of shareholder returns' after three years of 100% payouts. A new buyback or special-return statement on the Q3 call would land on a name trading well below cash.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-03-24 release (Q4'25) carried a 100% payout (regular plus special dividend, about 11% yield): +0.1% the next session. The August 2024 buyback came with the Q2'24 print; that reaction was not measured here. A dividend announcement has not paid on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market expected a new authorization, the stock would not sit at 0.59x net cash with negative EV and a -27% drift since the last print. This is inference: no document says a program is coming.
findings.independence: Program terms: FY2024 20-F https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1499543/000141057825000852/noah-20241231x20f.htm. Net cash and market cap: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/noah/statistics/. Management's 'comparable level' statement: Q2 call transcript https://www.webull.com/news/15479272959984640.

findings.finding: Positioning is washed out but not short-crowded. The stock is -27.2% since the Q2 print and -37% year to date, 3% above its 52-week low. Short interest is only 0.48% of shares (1.56 days to cover). An unexplained 3.82M-ADS volume day on 2026-11-19 (about 6.5x average) was followed by -6.3% and +4.9% sessions, so a large holder may have exited before the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None measurable. The last four prints moved -1.3% to +0.1% from a range of pre-print drifts.
findings.why_not_priced: It is the price itself. An unexplained drawdown is not evidence of overreaction, so it is sized 0 and filed for the panel.
findings.independence: Daily volume and closes: Yahoo chart https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/NOAH?range=3mo&interval=1d. Short interest: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/noah/statistics/.

findings.finding: Investment income may turn into a fair-value loss. Q2 2026 carried RMB41.8M of investment income, mainly fair-value gains on equity securities, and Q3 2025 net income was lifted above operating income by fair-value gains on affiliate investments. With the STAR 50 -31% and ChiNext -28% in Q3 2026, a mark-down below operating income is plausible and would widen the gap between GAAP NI and Q3 2025's 218.5M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3'25 GAAP NI +62.6% on affiliate fair-value gains with operating income -28.6%: the stock moved -0.5%. Below-the-line swings have not moved it.
findings.why_not_priced: The holdings are not itemised publicly, so nobody can mark them. It is a one-off below operating income with no path to the guide, so it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: Index moves: https://news.10jqka.com.cn/20261001/c680429794.shtml. This is a proxy: the specific holdings are unknown.

findings.finding: Some counterparty series held up better than the A-share index. East Money's Q3 2026 fund-distribution-led revenue line was +17.7% YoY (-6.6% QoQ), so mainland mutual-fund trailing fees probably did not collapse. The Hang Seng rose 7.6% in Q3 2026 (to 24,613 at 9-30), which supports the marks behind Noah's international asset-management fees. Both partly offset the first finding.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3'25: recurring service fees +5% while total revenue fell 7.4%, and the stock moved -0.5%. Recurring fees are not what this stock trades on at the print.
findings.why_not_priced: Peer and market series that few Noah followers read across. Their transmission to Noah's fee lines is unconfirmed, so this is small.
findings.independence: Hang Seng Q3: https://www.stheadline.com/zh-hans/stock-market/3620867/恒指全季升1732点-扭转三季跌势-药明生物累升62-专家料短期缺方向港股收市. That page reports the September close (24,613.27) matching the 2026-09-30 EastMoney close page https://finance.eastmoney.com/a/202609303887699720.html. These are two proxies from different sources.

outside_window.finding: The 2026 dividend decision (2025 was a 100% payout of non-GAAP NI, regular plus special) is normally announced with Q4 results in late March. The Q3 call may hint at it, but the decision falls after the window.

baseline_tension: There is no skew or implied move to cut against. The -8% 20-day and -27% post-print drift agree with my weak-quarter read, which is why that negative is sized small. The capital-return and below-cash angle cuts the other way, and the two roughly offset.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar unsourced or disputed: no quarterly consensus, two FY sources disagree): revenue finding capped at -0.8 from -1.0.
Rule 5 (an unexplained drawdown is worth 0): positioning finding cut from +0.5 to 0.0 and kept filed for the panel.
Rule 6 (inside the guided range): margin finding cut from -0.3 to -0.2, because it lands inside the ~30% full-year margin guide.
Rule 1 and the reaction history rebuilt from confirmed releases (-0.7, -1.3, +0.1, -0.5 on the last four): abs_move kept at 3.5 rather than raised, and reported-quarter findings kept small.

Rule 2 (one-off below operating income): fair-value finding cut from -0.3 to -0.2. The capital-return finding was trimmed from +0.8 to +0.6 because it is inference with no document saying a program is coming.
